hero.dedication:
For those who lived a thousand futures
with someone who was never truly theirs.
hero.lede: This book explores an under-examined form of intimacy, known as an almost-relationship. It is a compassionate guide that recognizes how a love that never quite began can still have an ending, and provides the means to promote healing by helping to separate what really happened from what you hoped would happen.

editionsIntro: Read it on Kindle today. The paperback and audiobook are on the way, and the Read-Along Edition, with narration on every page, arrives in January.
